description: This Java source file defines the UserValidator class, which implements the validation logic for User objects within the OpenMRS platform. It includes checks for user attributes such as username, email, and related person details, ensuring compliance with project-specific validation rules.

classes.name: UserValidator
classes.description: Validator class for User objects, implementing validation rules such as username format, email validity, and person details validation.

methods.name: supports
